newsitem.title: CHINA: China consumer product sales up 12 pct Jan-May.
newsitem.headline: China consumer product sales up 12 pct Jan-May.

text.p: Consumer product sales in China rose by an adjusted 12 percent in January-May versus the same period a year ago, the China Daily Business Weekly said on Sunday.
The newspaper said total consumer product sales in May were also up 12 percent on April,, largely due to increased sales of seasonal goods, including beverages, fruit and air conditioners.
The paper gave no comparisions for either period in the previous year.
Fierce competition among appliance manufacturers saw plunging prices and soaring sales particularly of televisions, video compact disc (VCD) players.
VCD player sales were up 56 percent in May over the same month last year, the paper said.
Domestic brands increasingly dominate the appliance sector due to improved quality and better after-sales service, it added.
